_about: Memory-value scorecard live scenarios. Each compares rusty-brain with realistic and steelman AGENTS.md baselines across five arms. Live outcomes are report-only except where an exact delivered-artifact assertion is declared. The fixed local exact evidence-ID assertion sidecar is the no-model-judge retrieval hard gate; complete live runs also require zero paired causal memory-induced errors and zero unassessable pairs.
